blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: The greatest talkers are the least doers.
exercises.ru: На посулы тароват, ___ на деле скуповат.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I am actually Welsh but I am living in Bristol.
exercises.ru: Вообще-то я валлиец, ___ живу в Бристоле.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: But maybe all this is subjective.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: For example in Bulgaria, shaking one's head means yes while nodding one's head means no.
exercises.ru: Например, в Болгарии мотание головой означает согласие, ___ кивание головой - несогласие.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: It wasn't just that she didn't blame him - she actually praised the guy.
exercises.ru: Она не просто не винила его, ___ даже и расхваливала.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The earth is a planet, and not a planetoid.

exercises.ru: Не имей друга потатчика, ___ имей друга поперечника.

exercises.q: I googled it, but I found nothing.

exercises.q: I used to be an adventurer like you, then I took an arrow in the knee.

exercises.q: I love candied chestnuts, but they are very sweet.
